$comment: Content of the README card pictures. Render with sh1ft-w.github.io/theme/v1/readme-images: node render.mjs <this repo> cards. The title image is built from tools/readme-title.html (photo instead of a window shot, see the comment there).

new.title: Quiet in standby
new.text: While the bar sleeps, Home Assistant only asks whether it is on. Switch it on and playback and settings are read right away.

new.title: Odd lists, no error
new.text: Unknown entries in the bar's EQ preset or rear speaker lists are skipped, the valid ones stay. A missing EQ band gives a clear message instead of a crash.

new.title: Host names work
new.text: Set up with a host name instead of an IP address? The audio format events now get through too, the sender check resolves the name on startup.

new.title: Calendar versions
new.text: Year, month and the release of that month: 26.10.2 is the second release of October 2026. The jump from 1.0.1 is intended, updates show up as usual.

features.title: A real media player
features.text: On and off, volume, mute, source (TV, HDMI, Bluetooth), play and pause, next and previous, title, artist and cover art while streaming.

features.title: True power state
features.text: Read straight from the bar instead of guessed from what is playing.

features.title: 7-band EQ and presets
features.text: JBL SIGNATURE, VOCAL, ENERGETIC, CHILL and your own preset, every band from 125 Hz to 8 kHz adjustable on its own.

features.title: Sound switches
features.text: Night mode, Smart mode, PureVoice and feedback tones, each one a switch.

features.title: Audio sync and sleep timer
features.text: Delay the sound by up to 250 ms, switch off after 15 minutes up to 2 hours.

features.title: Rear speakers
features.text: Battery, charging, docked and connected, each rear as its own device under the bar.

features.title: Dolby Atmos and audio format
features.text: See whether Atmos is coming in and in which format, for example ATMOS / DDP / 6ch / 48 kHz, pushed instantly by a UPnP event.

features.title: Adapts and starts instantly
features.text: Features a model does not know are never created. The event subscription runs in the background, Home Assistant does not wait for it.

entities.title: Media player
entities.text: media_player.jbl_bar_1000 is the main control: power, volume, mute, source, playback and now playing.

entities.title: Switches
entities.text: power, nightmode, smart_mode, pure_voice and feedback_tone.

entities.title: Volume and EQ bands
entities.text: volume from 0 to 100 % in 3 % steps like on the bar. 125hz to 8000hz from -6 to +6 dB (125 Hz down to -9 dB), changing a band creates your own preset.

entities.title: Audio sync and selects
entities.text: audio_sync from 0 to 250 ms. eq_preset and sleep_timer as selects, the remaining time as an attribute.

entities.title: Sensors
entities.text: source, audio_format and atmos_level, plus left_battery and right_battery per rear speaker.

entities.title: Binary sensors and buttons
entities.text: atmos_active, left/right charging, docked and online. Buttons for the remote: atmos, bass, moment, calibration and rear.

items.title: HTTPS + certificate
items.text: State, settings, EQ and source through the bar's local API, every 10 seconds.

items.title: UPnP / SOAP
items.text: Title, cover, volume and mute through the bar's media renderer.

items.title: UPnP events
items.text: The bar pushes the audio format to Home Assistant the moment it changes.

title.name: JBL Bar
title.sub: A real media player, the true power state, EQ, sound switches, rear speakers and the live Dolby Atmos format, the way the JBL One app talks to the bar. Fast, complete, no cloud.
